actions.sharedTitleOn: Visible to everyone — click to make it only yours
actions.sharedTitleOff: Only you can see it — click to share
actions.confirmDelete: Delete this song? It will be removed from every setlist.

notOwnerBanner: This song belongs to another user — only its creator (or an admin) can edit it directly. Click “Clone song” to create your own editable copy. Uploading audio/samples and deleting are also restricted to the creator.

tabs.normalizeTitle: Standardizes header, chord notation, and section labels — never touches the spacing between chords and lyrics

edit.aiSuggestTitle: Suggests performer, key, rhythm, and tags based on the lyrics — only fills in empty fields; you review and save
edit.executionTimeHint: Song length — sets the scroll speed in Scroll mode.
edit.observationTitle: Marks the current line as a note visible in karaoke
edit.hiddenObservationTitle: Marks the current line as a hidden note (doesn't show up in karaoke)
edit.soloTitle: Wraps the selected passage as a solo
edit.riffTitle: Wraps the selected passage as a riff
edit.tabTitle: Wraps the selected passage as tablature
edit.insertSampleTitle: Inserts [@sample] before the current line — plays automatically if the line has [t=SEG]
edit.confirmDiscard: Discard the unsaved changes to this song? This can't be undone.
edit.autosaveHint: Auto-save on · every save creates a version in the history
edit.youtubeUrlHint: Shows a mini player in karaoke mode and enables the "Play + YT" button.
edit.suggestYoutubeTitle: Search YouTube for a real video of this song (title + artist)
edit.suggestYoutubeNotFound: No video found for this song.

audio.synthDescription: Synthesizes drums/guitar/bass/keyboard from the chord sheet's chords — only takes over the karaoke stage in place of an actual recording; if a reference track is uploaded above, it always takes priority.
audio.bpmRequired: Set the BPM above to enable the instruments.
audio.noChord: No chords recognized in the chord sheet — bass/guitar/keyboard stay silent; only the drums play.
audio.pedalDescription: Control playback hands-free during your performance, using a USB pedal set up to send a key — the key itself is configured once, in Settings, and applies to every song.
audio.pedalFullTrackHint: The pedal key turns the reference track uploaded above on/off.
audio.helpPrefix: Use the 🔊 Sample button on the Edit tab to insert

clipQueue.title: Clip queue
clipQueue.hint: Each pedal press plays the next clip in the queue, interrupting the previous one if it's still playing. After the last one, the pedal does nothing until the page is reloaded.

versions.empty: No previous versions. Versions are created on every save.
versions.selectPrompt: Select a version to compare with the current one.
versions.confirmRestore: Restore this version? The current one will move to the history.
versions.noDiff: No differences in the chord sheet body.
